source.note: Headwords and IDs preserved from the existing iOS app. This is its American Oxford-based 3000-entry index, not an independently verified UK edition. Swedish translations and examples are original authored drafts.

entries.sentence: Jag ser en katt och ett äpple.
entries.sentenceEnglish: I see a cat and an apple.
entries.memoryHook: Learn each noun with en or ett.
entries.scene: A cat and an apple with labels en katt and ett äpple.
entries.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create ONE finished square illustrated Swedish vocabulary card for an adult-learning mobile app. The attached Finnish card is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE only; create entirely Swedish teaching content.
Match its polished tactile editorial realism, warm light, bold highly legible navy typography, cream header with thin warm gold edging, central memorable scene, short integrated teaching caption, and pale blue bottom example strip. No app chrome or watermark.
Lesson: English "a, an" corresponds to Swedish indefinite articles "en / ett"; Swedish noun gender determines which article, not the following sound.
Top header text VERBATIM: "en / ett"
Below header smaller VERBATIM: "a, an"
Central scene: one adorable realistic tabby CAT seated on a wooden table beside one juicy red APPLE. Clean blue Scandinavian room behind. Two large cream speech bubbles with clearly pointing tails: cat label VERBATIM "en katt"; apple label VERBATIM "ett äpple". Highlight "en" and "ett" in gold, keeping the noun words navy. The cat and apple should be separate clear silhouettes. Never use an English cat or apple label.
Short cream/gold caption near bottom of scene VERBATIM: "Learn each noun with en or ett."
Bottom pale blue strip with large exact Swedish sentence: "Jag ser en katt och ett äpple."
Only these supplied words may appear. Preserve Swedish ä exactly (two dots). Sentence spelling: J-a-g s-e-r e-n k-a-t-t o-c-h e-t-t ä-p-p-l-e. Use generous margins and clear hierarchy. Integrated text is essential. Single image, not a contact sheet.

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. One strong central scene occupies about two thirds. All supplied teaching text MUST be rendered INSIDE the image. Preserve Swedish å, ä, ö and every letter exactly. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or unsupplied paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims.
Header text verbatim: "ett skjutvapen". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "gun".
Scene: A police evidence technician documenting a secured firearm lying untouched in an open car boot, no threatening action or injury.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "skjuta + vapen = shoot + weapon.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Polisen hittade ett skjutvapen i bilen.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
